DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 33 s. 2022 April 26, 2022 SANGGUNIANG BAYAN MEMBERS Municipality of Manay Province of Davao Oriental Dear SB Members: This refers to the letter-complaint dated January 31, 2022 of Mayor Japhet M. Quibo, concerning the alleged inaction of Sangguniang Bayan to approve the budget proposal for CY 2022. As represented in the subject letter, on October 15, 2021, the office of herein concerned local chief executive has transmitted its Budget Proposal to the Sangguniang Bayan. Ostensibly, the Sangguniang Bayan has not acted on it. Consequently, herein concerned Sangguniang Bayan is now operating on a re- enacted budget, after the Sangguniang Bayan fails to act on the submitted budget proposal. It is intimated therein that with the Sangguniang Bayan intent of not approving aforesaid budget, herein concerned Municipality has sacrificed so much in implementing its regular operation. Apparently, the implementation of developmental projects were hampered. Hence, Mayor Quibo is requesting for this Department's intervention to advise the Sangguniang Bayan of Manay to approve and adopt its General Fund for CY 2022. At the outset, it is this Department's view that the duty of the Sanggunian under Section 323 of the Local Government Codel is mandatory and failure of the sanggunian to comply therewith would make them vulnerable to a possible Section 323. Failure to Enact the Annual Appropriations. - In case the sanggunian concerned fails to pass the ordinance authorizing the annual appropriations at the beginning of the ensuing fiscal year, it shall continue to hold sessions, without additional remuneration for its members, until such ordinance is approved, and no other business may be taken up during such sessions. If the sanggunian still fails to enact such ordinance after ninety (90) days from the beginning of the fiscal year, the ordinance authorizing the appropriations of the preceding year shall be deemed reenacted and shall remain in force and effect until the ordinance authorizing the proposed appropriations is passed by the sanggunian concerned. However, only the annual appropriations for salaries and wages of existing positions, statutory and contractual obligations. and essential operating expenses authorized in the annual and supplemental budgets for the preceding year shall be deemed reenacted and disbursement of funds shall be in accordance therewith. In the implementation of such reenacted ordinance, the local treasurer concemed shall exclude from the estimates of income for the preceding fiscal year those realized from nonrecurring sources, like national aids, proceeds from loans, sale of assets, prior year adjustments, and other analogous sources of income. No ordinance authorizing supplemental appropriations shall be passed in place of the annual appropriations. In case the revised income estimates be less than the aggregate reenacted appropriations, the local treasurer concerned shall accordingly advise the sanggunian concerned which shall, within ten (IO) days from the receipt of such advice, make the necessary adjustments or reductions. The revised appropriations authorized by the Sanggunian concemed shall then be the basis for disbursements. Matino. Mahusav at Maasahan"

administrative case of dereliction of duty (DILG Legal Opinion No. 110 s. 2020, dated June 28, 2010). In this regard, herein concerned Chairman of the Appropriations Committee and the other members of the sanggunian are hereby reminded of their mandated •tasks under Section 323 of the Code, which provides that in case the Sanggunian concerned failed to pass the ordinance authorizing the annual appropriations at the beginning of the fiscal year, it shall continue to hold sessions, without additional remuneration for its members, until such ordinance is approved, and no other business may be taken up during such sessions. Further, pursuant to DILG Memorandum Circular (MC) 2022-004 dated January 19, 2022 dated January 19, 2022, all elective local officials who will fail to submit and/or enact appropriation ordinance within the timeline provided [in the aforesaid DILG MCJ to submit a written explanation under oath cogent explanations, reasons, and justifications for the nonfeasance in enacting the annual appropriation ordinance. Accordingly, we hereby reiterate the compliance of herein concerned sanggunian to the directive contained in the aforecited DILG MC. Very truly yours, By the Authority of the Secretary: GAN Undersec ary for Local Government OUSLG/MLl/LLLS-LRALLD/jam Dir. ALEX C. ROLDAN, CESO V Regional Director, DILG-XI 58 McArthur Highway, Matina Davao City, Davao del Sur Mayor JAPHET M. QUIBO Municipality of Manay Davao Oriental Page 2 of 2
